integrity: Complete mathematical proof with an independently executable, standard-library-only finite checker. Finite tests do not independently validate all primes or levels.
scientific_limitations: Odd primes only; one fixed quadratic shift family and uniform parameters. The pointwise p-adic period lemma is not claimed as original. Infinite formulas are proved, while code only checks finite cases; more general implicit coverage remains possible.
title: Exact parameter census and covariance signs for quadratic near-identity permutations
